read.en: Corning slipped 0.2% on Oct 23 to $123.69, trading between $121.80 and $126.75. It is below the falling 5-day ($129.5), 10-day ($135.5), 30-day ($148.6) and 100-day ($164.2) averages and the rising 200-day ($154.7). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and is below zero; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 12 ($145.37), and RSI is 33.

The $121.8 low undercut Wednesday's $122.6 low, but the close held near the $123.9 Mar 19 low; the $126.75 high stopped under the $126.7–127.6 resistance. Resistance is $126.7–127.6, then $129.5–132.75 (5-day, Oct 15 low) and $135.5 (10-day). Support is $121.8–123.9, then $120 (Mar 9 low) and $114.5 (Jul 28 low). A close above $127.6 would target $132.75; a close below $121.8 would open $120.
